boatToursIncluded: Every boat tour includes hotel transfer, lunch and snorkel gear.

tours.name: 4 Islands
tours.description: Koh Ma, Koh Mook and Koh Chueak, plus Koh Kradan or Koh Ngai: your choice.
tours.photoAlt: Our longtail boat on clear turquoise water

tours.name: Koh Rok & Koh Haa
tours.description: Snorkeling around the islands of the Mu Ko Lanta National Park.
tours.photoAlt: A longtail boat moored on a white sand beach under the trees

tours.name: Koh Phi Phi
tours.description: A day trip to the Phi Phi islands, with Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon, Monkey Beach and snorkeling stops.
tours.photoAlt: A longtail boat moored by the limestone cliffs of Koh Phi Phi

tours.name: Koh Talabeng & Koh Bubu
tours.description: Kayaking around the limestone islets of Koh Talabeng, then a beach stop on Koh Bubu.
tours.photoAlt: Two people kayaking past limestone islands

tours.name: Mangroves
tours.description: Through the mangroves by longtail, gondola or kayak.
tours.photoAlt: A longtail boat cruising through the mangroves

tours.name: Fishing trip
tours.description: A fishing trip on a longtail off the coast of Koh Lanta.
tours.photoAlt: Fishing from a boat at sunset

activities.name: Island day tour by songthaew
activities.description: Old Town, viewpoints and beaches around Koh Lanta in a local songthaew.
activities.photoAlt: A songthaew parked in Lanta Old Town

activities.name: Scuba diving
activities.description: Try diving for a day, or train from Open Water up to advanced and rescue. Small groups.
activities.photoAlt: A scuba diver beside a coral reef, with a school of small silver fish and a clownfish in an anemone

activities.name: ATV (quad bike)
activities.description: An ATV ride on the dirt tracks of Koh Lanta.
activities.photoAlt: ATVs parked on a hilltop track with a view over Koh Lanta

activities.name: Kayaking
activities.description: Sea caves, mangroves and island hopping by kayak, from a half day to a full day.

activities.name: Ethical elephant sanctuary
activities.description: Feeding and walking with the elephants, no riding.
activities.photoAlt: An elephant at an ethical sanctuary

activities.name: Thai cooking class
activities.description: A visit to the local market, then cook Thai dishes with a local cook. Suitable for children.
activities.photoAlt: A Thai cooking class with a local chef

activities.name: Batik painting
activities.description: Paint your own batik canvas with a local instructor, or add a kayak trip to the sea cave.

activities.name: Electric go-kart
activities.description: Small and large electric karts, single or double seats, and koi fish to feed.

activities.name: Car and scooter rental
activities.description: Scooters, big bikes, cars and pick-ups to explore the island.

transfers.name: Speedboat and ferry
transfers.description: Speedboats from Koh Lanta to Phi Phi, Phuket, the islands and Langkawi.
